_comment: Tier-2 for sparta adaptive_grid and hypersonic_flow: 'fix adapt' refines without limit unless 'maxlevel' caps it, and nothing warns. Two decks were run on the installed binary (SPARTA 24 Sep 2025, spa_serial) differing only by the trailing 'maxlevel 2' on one 'fix adapt 100 all refine particle 5 0' line. Uncapped, Ngrid climbs on every stats line and Maxlevel reaches 3 while Np is identical on all seven lines and the per-cell particle MINIMUM falls from above one to zero and the per-cell average more than halves — so the very quantity driving the adaptation has become noise. Capped, Maxlevel never exceeds 2 and Ngrid saturates. Both runs exit 0 with no error and no warning, which is the point: this is a silent failure. Every assertion is a column shape (flat, climbing, saturating) or a comparison between the two decks; no cell count is pinned, because the counts a refinement produces depend on the seed and the particle distribution. COVERS: adaptive_grid:2, hypersonic_flow:5. MUTATION CONTROL (added 2026-08-06, re-runnable): T2_MUTATE=1 gives the "uncapped" deck the same `maxlevel 2` cap as the control, removing the unbounded-refinement pathology and nothing else; both Ngrid columns then saturate at 400 and both Maxlevel columns stop at 2. Verified: unmutated the fixture PASSES (rc=0); with T2_MUTATE=1 it FAILS (rc=1) and these expect_in_output strings go False and disappear: uncapped_ngrid_climbs_every_stats_line=True, uncapped_maxlevel_exceeds_the_cap=True, uncapped_ends_with_more_cells_than_capped=True. Re-verify: cd scripts/tier2_fixtures/sparta/refinement_is_unbounded_without_maxlevel && python source.py (passes, rc=0), then T2_MUTATE=1 python source.py (fails, rc=1). Needs a SPARTA binary: the fixtures find spa_serial/spa_mpi on PATH or at ~/Schreibtisch/sparta/src/spa_serial, else set SPARTA_BINARY; with none present they exit 0 on a SKIP: line.
